sentences.en: He was a skilled strategist and canny political operator.
sentences.zh: 他是一位技艺高超的战略家和精明的政治操盘手。

sentences.en: The company hired a new business strategist to improve its market position.
sentences.zh: 公司聘请了一位新的商业战略家来改善其市场地位。

sentences.en: She aspired to be a military strategist in the armed forces someday.
sentences.zh: 她希望将来能在武装部队里成为一名军事战略家。
